source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Hódie afflíctus sum valde, * sed cras solvam víncula mea.
text.en: Today I am greatly afflicted, * but tomorrow I will break my bonds.

text.la: Cum his, * qui odérunt pacem, eram pacíficus: dum loquébar illis, impugnábant me gratis.
text.en: With them * that hated peace I was peaceable: when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.

text.la: Ab homínibus * iníquis líbera me, Dómine.
text.en: From unjust men * deliver me, O Lord.

text.la: Custódi me * a láqueo, quem statuérunt mihi, et a scándalis operántium iniquitátem.
text.en: Keep me * from the snare, which they have laid for me, and from the stumbling-blocks of them that work iniquity.

text.la: Considerábam * ad déxteram, et vidébam, et non erat qui cognósceret me.
text.en: I looked * on my right hand, and beheld, and there was no one that would know me.

text.la: Príncipes sacerdótum * et pharisǽi muniérunt sepúlcrum, signántes lápidem, cum custódibus.
text.en: The chief priests * and the Pharisees made the sepulcher sure, sealing the stone and setting guards.
